items.actClause: AN ACT to amend the environmental conservation law, in relation to establishing the open season for hunting coyote in certain circumstances
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER:  S2510      Revised 4/3/17

 TITLE OF BILL :  An act to amend the environmental conservation law,
in relation to establishing the open season for hunting coyote in
certain circumstances

 PURPOSE :

Provides that the open season for hunting coyotes shall be all year
long in certain instances.

 SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS :

Section 1 of this measure amends paragraph o of subdivision 2 of
section 11-0905 of the Environmental Conservation Law to allow the
open season for hunting coyote to be all year, provided that the
county legislature passes a resolution authorizing such hunting within
the county.

Section 2 provides for an immediate effective date.

 JUSTIFICATION :

Coyote populations have grown exponentially and have caused environ-
mental and social difficulties. Many localities have reported
increases in the coyote population stating that they have become a
nuisance to people's properties as well as a danger to their pets and
livestock. To combat these problems, seasonal restrictions should be
lifted so that coyote populations can be controlled more effectively.

 LEGISLATIVE HISTORY :

2015/2016: S.6221

 FISCAL IMPLICATIONS :

None.

 EFFECTIVE DATE :
This act shall take effect immediately.
